achievement.name: Ambulance Driver Certificate
achievement.description: Certifies the holder is authorized to operate an ambulance under applicable motor vehicle laws.

criteria.narrative: The holder has completed a certified ambulance driver training program, passed a written knowledge examination, and met all medical fitness requirements as prescribed by applicable state regulations.
